QUOTE: "`EngineCallbacks::on_tool_call` returns `void`, and `check_approval` sets `approved = true` after calling it (`tool_executor.cpp:168-173`). With a callback registered, every call not on the allow list runs unless the deny list stops it."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the callback returns void and approved is set to true after it is called, so it cannot refuse.
